Verbrauch WP GH in der Periode

targets.query:
from(bucket: "cloudbktcp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "ePower")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "actW")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["eMeter"] == "VHWP")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "wpvh_power")

  from(bucket: "bktRP4GH")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "ePowerWP")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["meter"] == "WPGH")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["mptype"] == "actPower")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "wpgh_power")

from(bucket: "cloudbktcp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "Gas")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "gascnt")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, column: "_field", fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |>derivative(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
   r with
    _value:  r._value*105.0*3600.0
     }))
  |> yield(name: "gas")

from(bucket: "dwdbkt")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "weather")

  |>drop (columns: ["_start","_stop", "quality" ])

  |> rename(columns: {_value: "airtemp"})
  |> yield(name: "airtemp")

import "contrib/tomhollingworth/events"

from(bucket: "LiviusStats")
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gasstat")
    // |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_stop", "_measurement"])
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "gasrate")
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, columns: ["gasrate"])
    |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "gascnt_delta")
    |> difference(columns: ["gascnt_delta"])
    |> elapsed()
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["gascnt_delta"] >1)
